meta.description: Every deadline at once, on a 15-minute cron. Sweeps the whole book, escalates what a human can still save, and rebuilds shipment memory once a night. Slide 04's 'CUT OFF SENTINEL' tile.

nodes.name: Every 15 minutes
nodes.notes: 15 minutes is chosen against the thing being watched: gate-in cut-offs move in hours, not seconds. Escalation is at-most-once per commitment on the SHIPMATE side, so a tighter cron would not produce more alerts, only more load.

nodes.name: Anything a human must see?
nodes.notes: A quiet sweep sends nothing. The whole value of this alert is that it is rare enough to be read.

parameters.content:
## Wire your own channel here

The digest arrives as `{{ $json.text }}`, already formatted.

Add a WhatsApp / Slack / email node after this one. It is left unconnected on purpose — the deck's outbound-call leg (slide 05) needs a SnapServe outbound campaign, and whichever channel you pick should be a decision, not a default someone inherits.

nodes.name: Nightly at 02:00 IST
nodes.notes: 20:30 UTC is 02:00 IST. Cognify is slow and CPU-heavy; running it while the desk is asleep keeps it off the path of a live call.

nodes.name: Rebuild shipment memory (Cognee)
nodes.notes: Builds the knowledge graph over everything added since the last run. 10-minute timeout — a night's calls can take a while and a truncated cognify leaves the graph half-built.
